- executor class at the founding encounter: non-copier 20
- partner class: non-copier 19, open copier 1
- the founding executor produces F in ≥ half of random encounters: 10 of 20 (in all 64: 10)

- bytes of F in neither parent: median 4 (range 0–10); at best shifts median 4 (0–10)

- executor copies its executed bytes (≥ 75% of them in ≥ half of runs; copier by executed bytes): 9 of 20; non-copier by both criteria: 11 of 20
- executor's pointer entered the partner in the founding encounter itself: 8 of 20
- share of 512 soup partners with which the founding executor makes F: median 0.86; among executors that are non-copiers by both criteria, max 1.00
- founder is a copy of an open copier (copyA from an open-copier partner): 0 of 20
- bytes of F in neither parent, each 8-byte half at its own best shifts: median 1 (range 0–8); at most 1 in 10 of 20
- events on the chains before the founder (all 17): 228; point mutations 55 (0.24); partial overwrite 102, rewrite (neither copy nor ≥ 75% own) 56, copy 10, copy of the partner 5
